dex.entry: A stocky boulder-torso kin with a cracked surface revealing faint mineral veins; it rolls defensively when threatened. The middle stage that looks like it means business — mineral veins hint at the spectacular final form.

art.silhouette: Squat, wide-shouldered stone body with visible grey-white mineral veins along arms; amber eyes now set in a craggy brow ridge; four sturdy legs planted firmly.
